integrity: The proof derives the matrix commutation equation directly, reduces the problem to pairwise nonzero determinants, proves the projective-line upper bound for all nonzero vectors using local factorization and the Chinese remainder theorem, and matches it with unimodular projective generators. The packaged checker verifies the structural ingredients for moduli \(2\) through \(40\) and exact reduced maxima for moduli \(2\) through \(6\).
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns \(2\times2\) upper triangular matrices over \(\mathbb Z/n\mathbb Z\).
It determines the independence number but does not classify all maximum independent sets.
The projective-line cardinality is standard; the new assertion is its exact equality with this commuting-graph invariant.
A later or differently indexed solution to the 2024 question may exist despite the searches performed.
title: Exact independence number for triangular commuting graphs over residue rings
